articles.title: Canada Leader Answers Trump's "Lake America" With Giant "Lake Ontario" Sign

articles.summary: A shooting at a rave party in Aarau, Switzerland left one dead and five injured, some in critical condition. Authorities are investigating the motive and suspect the gunman was armed with a handgun.
